column2: Have a 3.0 cumulative GPA. Have 30+ transferable credit hours from an accredited community college. Letter of Recommendation from PTK Advisor.

Recipients must complete a minimum of 30 credit hours annually at HSSU between the fall and spring semesters and maintain a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better. Renewable for up to six (6) semesters or completing an undergraduate degree.
